content.text: Discussed on committer call 2011-03-22 - if it looks like too much effort to implement validation against local copies, instead just disable the validation entirely based on a system property.
Example code for validating against filesystem schema:
http://www.edankert.com/validate.html#validate_external_schema_SAX
So, we should I think just be able to pass in an array containing all the schemata (eg by walking the directory for xsd files)
is this ticket actually a sub-task of FCREPO-713?

I'm not sure if validating against local schemata will actually work for the "on an aeroplane" situation - I just hit a validation error to do with an xml:lang attribute, presumably because of a connection failure to
http://www.w3.org/XML/1998/namespace
(though I guess we could download all of the dependent schemata as well).  So being able to turn off validation entirely (as discussed on the call on Apr 26th 2011) would be a good idea in any case.
I've been trying to get this to work for quite some time.  The source of my consternation seems to be a bug in xerces:
https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/XERCESJ-1130
Basically, one cannot define a Schema using two component Schemas with the same namespace.
As an example, in order to validate datastream history, two schemas are needed, datastreamHistory.xsd and datastreamProfile.xsd.  They both use the namespace
http://www.fedora.info/definitions/1/0/management/
.  Due to the bug in Xerces, pseudocode
schema = schemaFactory.newSchema([datasteamHistory.xsd, datastreamProfile.xsd])
will produce a schema will end up equivalent to:
schema = schemaFactory.newSchema(datastreamProfile.xsd)
so you will get an error that no datastreamHistory element can be found.
I cannot find a simple way around this bug.. producing a single schema file by "concatinating" the two might possibly work, but I haven't tried that yet
I believe this still applies to xerces 2.11, but I have not tried it, as neither xerces 2.10 or 2.11 is in Maven central
Very annoying that such a well known and critical apache project can't or won't update their artifacts in maven central.
Maybe we could also find some other implementation of javax.xml.validation.Validator?
There's this list of JAXP parsers:
http://www.edankert.com/jaxpimplementations.html
For this release I think it would be acceptable to just disable the validation, eg a -Dvalidation.rest.skip=true
Probably a separate JIRA issue for this; and carry forward this ticket to the next release.
Doesn't the /validate method do schema validation - I think against local schemata?
And org.fcrepo.server.validation.DOValidatorXMLSchema looks like it does this.

I think offline schema validation is effectively impossible for this release given what's available in maven central, so disabling validation is the only plausible approach now.  I've been using -Doffline=true (and/or -Donline=false), and will just leave the offline schema validation disabled in the code.
No further releases planned for 3.x
If a system property is set (name tbd) then validate against local file copies of schemata rather than online version.  Default should be validation against online schemata
